whatTheyRan: Offense: shotgun, spread the field, Baugh downhill, hitch when corners sit, go when they cheat the run. Pistol is one look. Sneak / under-center is not the offense.

Defense: Brad White’s odd front — three down, JACK (Jayden Woods), STAR, Graham at WILL. A TV count of four rushers is three down + JACK coming. Coverage mixes Cover 3 / quarters / man — name the shell on that snap.
Specials: Florida never punts. Durkin from 53. FAU’s 18-yard punt starts the second Florida score.
howItPlayed: They stretched the field, ran Baugh, and threw it now when the defense sat.
Coleman INT on FAU’s opening drive (3rd-and-10 at FLA 35).
Secondary issues were miscommunication / not getting the same call — not a pile of missed tackles.
Sledge keep: design was sound; they lost the play.
doNotSay: four down as the Florida front
